title.narrative: Netherlands Pavilion at Uganda International Trade Fair

description.narrative: Following a two-year absence due to the outbreak of the corona pandemic, the Netherlands embassy in Kampala, Uganda will set up a Dutch Pavilion at the Uganda International Trade Fair (UGITF), an annual event organised by Uganda Manufacturers Association (UMA). This year’s edition is scheduled to take place from the 3rd to the 10th of October at the UMA Lugogo Show Grounds.The Uganda International Trade Fare (UGITF) is the premier business development and networking event of the country and one of the national calendar events that have grown tremendously over the last 28 editions; attracting more than 1,000 manufacturers, traders, and distributors from almost every business sector; with an average of 30,000 show guests daily.This Trade Fair will be held from the 3rd - 10th of October 2022 and is expected to attract over 350,000 visitors. The theme for the fair is "Business recovery by harnessing local sourcing and deepening value chains integration”. It is anticipated that the event will showcase businesses that have demonstrated resilience and ably navigated the minefield of the COVID-19 pandemic to emerge as successful businesses post the COVID-19 pandemic.The Private Sector in Uganda is dominated by SMEs that are engaged in various segments of the different Value chains where they operate. SMEs in both service provision (such as finance, insurance, ICT, and logistics management), production (primary/secondary levels including dealers in production inputs/services) and value addition (processing) will participate. In general, the Trade Fair is open to participation from all sectors e.g., agriculture, manufacturing, electrical, chemicals, petroleum products, plastics, rubber, packaging, leather, tourism, foods and beverages, education services, auto industry etc. The fair highlights market opportunities in Uganda and the wider East African Community market for both local and foreign companies.The core goal of this project is setting up a Netherlands Pavilion that will help companies in expanding marketing opportunities for Dutch companies and Ugandan companies with a Dutch link, based in Uganda. To achieve this objective, the Netherlands Pavilion will host Matchmaking Sessions and brokerage support services. The goal is to link Ugandan companies to Dutch suppliers, enhance Dutch brand visibility and create a knowledge-sharing link that fosters productive and sustainable trade and investment.Moreover, with a growing network of Dutch and Ugandan companies in various sectors, the UGITF presents a platform for:1. Dutch and Ugandan companies to market and brand their innovative products and services;2. Identifying, developing and consolidating new and pre-existing synergies with other business partners;3. The Netherlands embassy in Kampala, Uganda and UMA will support companies to follow-up viable business links through Matchmaking and site-visits.Lastly, both the Netherlands embassy in Kampala, Uganda and UMA will proactively link companies to the relevant Business Facilitation Agencies such as Uganda Revenue Authority, Uganda Export Promotion Board, and Uganda Private Sector Foundation among others.Participation Profile Dutch Pavilion attendantsThe Dutch Pavilion will host small- and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) across various sectors. The exhibition space will be used by entrepreneurs with a strong link with the Netherlands embassy in Kampala, Uganda (EKN), or the Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO):• Dutch companies active in Uganda;• Ugandan companies trained by EKN/RVO-funded projects;• Entrepreneurs from the Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) programme;• Entrepreneurs with the Dutch Good Growth Fund (DGGF) finance;• Non-gouvernmental organisations (NGOs) and civil society with a Dutch link, active in stimulating private sector development (PSD);• etc.The fair takes a full week, so exhibition space will be used efficiently (entrepreneurs normally don’t have a week time to be present, so exhibition space can be shared).
